title: Robotic vision-based inspection for surface roughness estimation in wood — code, dataset and trained models
description:
Code, image dataset, reference profilometry measurements and trained model weights supporting a multimodal convolutional neural network that estimates the surface roughness parameters Ra and Rz from grazing-light images of robotically sanded Chilean oak (Nothofagus obliqua), acquired in a dual-robot sanding and inspection cell.

Includes 1248 image patches from 7 specimens, each paired with a contact-profilometry measurement of the same area, the leave-one-specimen-out cross-validation splits, the training and evaluation code, the published model weights, and the scripts that regenerate every figure and table of the paper.
